name: BACH_0385_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
One-class conformal set, second-model agreement, and 5/5 similar cases Invasive [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Strongly peaked |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scant benign stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Low overall; concept model links this to invasive · Validated
- **Few gland/tubule structures** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Low overall; same association · Validated
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 2, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Raised score; do not rely on it · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Mildly raised score; small contribution · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 8, 11) · context · Raised score; descriptive only · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Normal lobules and mitoses (both 0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) misleads; the reliability score only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration test set is small (n=132); ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5**: look for benign stroma, glands or lobules; their scores are highest here.
2. **Regions 10, 7, 8**: lowest per-region invasive risk (0.17, 0.31, 0.37); confirm invasive growth.
3. **Border regions 0–4, 7–11**: verify the "tumor at margin" call on all four edges [F7].
